notes.title: The Demo is live for the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Our Steam Next Fest demo is live! 
This is your chance to step into the shoes of a commander ahead of the full release later this year! This demo contains a shortened version of the early-game and your first taste of combat.

[previewyoutube=Cga-BcQXV2Q;full][/previewyoutube]
The Siege of Jeomdo is a narrative-driven, roleplaying game set on the island of Jeomdo: home of artisans, master craftsmen and humble families.


 Face the weight of leadership in this grounded, character-driven story.
 Manage time and resources to prepare for war with the help of the Requisition system.
 Face a brutal, choice-driven battle where preparation meets consequences.

Go and download it! The Siege of Jeomdo - Demo Page
Please share it with your friends or leave us a review - we'd love to hear what you all think.
